subject: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

Hi Aisha & Raj,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really appreciated the candid product questions. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) I pulled together based on our notes: high-level milestones, suggested owners, and target dates. This is intentionally lightweight so we can iterate.

Key asks from me for this week:
- Please review the milestone owners column and update if your internal owners differ.
- Confirm the proposed go-live window (we suggested week of 2026-09-13). If that needs to move earlier/later, tell us which constraints (security review, procurement, integrations).
- If security needs a questionnaire, loop them in and we’ll prioritize responses.

I've cc'd Ben (sales) who will track procurement/contract milestones, and can help with the DocuSign timeline. Once we lock owners/dates I’ll loop Marissa from CS for a formal handoff and weekly sync cadence.

Attachment: nimble_MAP_v1.xlsx (simple milestone table)

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: security@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

Camila — thanks for putting this together, looks tidy and actionable. Quick comments inline:
- We need the go-live pushed one week later to the week of 2026-09-20 to allow for an internal compliance gating meeting on 9/15.
- Integration owner: please change "Integrations" owner to Raj (copied).
- Security asked to receive the standard questionnaire and any requested logs matrix. I’ve cc'd our security alias.

We also prefer a weekly 30-min sync on Fridays. If Marissa can host the first three, that would be great.

Aisha Khan
VP, Product Operations | NimbleHealth
aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

Thanks — looping in the procurement notes here.
- We can accommodate the one-week shift to 2026-09-20.
- I’ll prepare the initial SOW timing (target sign: 2026-08-15) and a DocuSign draft; I’ll share the link by EOD Wed.
- Pricing note: committed Dedicated capacity option will require an addendum — I’ll mark this as an action item and attach a redline-ready clause in the DocuSign envelope.

Deliverables I’ll owner: SOW draft, DocuSign envelope, pricing addendum.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0188

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

Hi team — happy to take the CS handoff. A few things from a delivery perspective:

1) Weekly cadence: Friday 30-min stand, starting 2026-07-09, recurring for 12 weeks then reevaluate.
2) Kickoff (internal + customer): proposed 2026-07-16 at 10:00 PT — sync to confirm stakeholders.
3) Acceptance criteria per milestone (short list):
   - Connectors deployed in staging + smoke test (integration owner).
   - Latency & throughput baseline verified against agreed SLA (performance).
   - Security questionnaire answered and attestations provided (security).

I attached our internal onboarding checklist and a compact copy of the MAP with CS column added. I’ll also create a shared drive doc where we’ll track open work and blockers.

Attachments: nimble_security_request.pdf; nimble_CS_onboarding_checklist.docx

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: security@nimblehealth.com <security@nimblehealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

Thanks — we received the attachment. Two quick asks from security:
1) Can you provide an expected retention window for logs relating to inference requests and a sample logs matrix?
2) Will the deployment use a customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed KMS for key encryption?

If you prefer, we can put these in a short call and route to our InfoSec engineer.

Regards,
NimbleHealth Security Team
security@nimblehealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimblehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, security@nimblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared MAP & operational docking runway for NimbleHealth

All — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and next steps:
- Go-live window updated to week of 2026-09-20 (per Aisha).
- Kickoff meeting set for 2026-07-16 10:00 PT (Marissa to send invite).
- Ben will deliver SOW draft and DocuSign envelope by 2026-07-01 EOD.
- Security: Marissa and I will respond to the retention matrix + KMS options; we can schedule a 30-min technical call with NimbleHealth InfoSec the week of 2026-07-06.

I’ve attached version 1.1 of the MAP with updated dates/owners. Please confirm owners inline on the doc or reply-all.

Attachment: Nimble_MAP_v1.1.xlsx

Looking forward to the kickoff — I’ll follow up with calendar invites and the shared tracking doc link.

Best,
Camila
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
